reviews.review_title: This is actually a really good
reviews.review_description:
For $2.99 I wasn't expecting much, but it's actually pretty good. Alot better than most of the games that are $9.99-$15.99. It has a decent amount of product. I've run into no glitches. I could easily put things on the shelves and pick up the boxes. Controls are comfortable. At first I thought there were only gonna be 2 different looking customers (not that I care too much about that) but the higher you go the more of a variety there is. Checking out is fun. Cash and Card. And The higher you go up in levels the more customers you have. You definitely don't get bored waiting for them. I enjoyed playing it. I'm a little confused about the other 3 stores. I'm not sure if they are another place I'm supposed to go, or just supposed to be part of my chain I'm supposed to make money on and not see. Either way, it's well worth it for $2.99. To be honest it's worth more if you compare to the other crappy supermarket games. 
I wanted to make sure to leave a review for people like me who love supermarket games. Most of the time you waste money because people don't leave accurate reviews. Mostly they don't leave reviews at all. 
Nice game.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for your wonderful and thoughtful review! ❤️ We're really happy to hear that you're enjoying the game and that you find it worth the price. Our goal was to keep the game affordable so that everyone can have the chance to enjoy it, and it means a lot to us to know that you appreciate both the experience and the value.

Your feedback and support motivate us to keep improving and adding more to the game. We're especially glad that you enjoy the checkout mechanics and the progression system.

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience and help other supermarket game lovers discover our game. We truly appreciate your support! 🛒💙
